overview: Caribbean Beach is a Moderate resort made up of colorful island-style villages around a lake. It's the central hub of the Skyliner, so getting to Epcot and Hollywood Studios is easy.
suits: Families who want more space and better pools than a Value resort, with easy Skyliner access.
rooms: Standard rooms sleep four, and many sleep five with a fold-down bed. Rooms are spread across several villages, some much farther from the main building than others.
pools: The main pool is at Old Port Royale, themed to a Spanish fort, with water slides and splash areas. Several quieter pools are spread around the villages.
dining: Sebastian's Bistro is the table-service restaurant, and Centertown Market is the quick-service food court.
pros: Skyliner hub with direct gondolas to Epcot and Hollywood Studios
Room for five in many rooms
cons: Very spread out, so some rooms are a long walk
Internal bus stops can mean extra waiting
Buses to Magic Kingdom and Animal Kingdom
tips: Request a room near the Skyliner station or Old Port Royale.
You can walk the lake path to the Riviera Resort and use the Skyliner from either station.
bestFor: Families who want Moderate comfort and the Skyliner.
